pull_requests.title: Redact install tokens in build logs

issue.body:
# Course navigation update

Rework the sidebar so nested lessons are easier to scan.

- Simplify breadcrumb depth
- Highlight the active module
- See [the navigation spec](docs/x.md) for details

<script>window.injected=1</script>

- [x] Confirm mobile layout matches design

reviews.summary: The change is correct and scoped to the navigation module. It moves the breadcrumb state into the store, adds tests for the collapsed variant, and leaves the public component API untouched. One nit: the helper could be named after what it returns rather than after the page that calls it.

The install token is still written to the build log on a failed upload. The retry path logs the whole request, including the Authorization header, before it raises; redact the header at the logging boundary instead of at the call site.
